inputs.source: Attached workbook snapshot; original Google Sheet unchanged
inputs.selection_policy: Use explicitly named latest heuristic tabs, not inferred modification dates. Export all other distinct sheet roles.
inputs.reviewer_mapping: Matched all 600 labels per reviewer to the existing independent annotation CSV; no names exported.
inputs.value_policy: Cached cell text preserved; formulas, styling, hyperlinks, comments and out-of-range notes excluded. Blanks and Unverified preserved.

live_source_check.policy: Exact supplied Google Sheets source read through connector. Exported values retain attached workbook numeric text; live sheet names containing reviewer identities are not distributed.

uncertainty_restoration.policy: Only unknown assessment predictions restored to ?. All known binary decisions preserved. Scan completeness is retained separately, not inferred from label values.
